definitions.tagged: Tagged = an item (post, comment, review) that went through the final (round 2) coding pass and received a label.
definitions.relevant: Relevant = a tagged item the engine rated Y (clear) or P (partial): it carries real evidence for at least one of the nine research questions. Items rated N are tagged but not relevant.
definitions.lapse_story: Lapse story = a relevant item whose author says they stopped, paused or reduced their SIP. People only considering stopping are not counted.

questions.Q1: Why do people start a SIP, and what do they expect?
questions.Q2: What changes in their behaviour in the months after starting?
questions.Q3: What leads them to pause, reduce or stop?
questions.Q4: What do they check, and how often?
questions.Q6: What do they do outside the app when unsure?
questions.Q7: What separates those who continue from those who drop off?
questions.Q8: How do patterns differ across segments?
questions.Q9: What unmet needs come up again and again?

metric_tree.B2: Can afford to keep paying, and can adjust
metric_tree.B4: Trusts the platform and gets help
metric_tree.B5: Has no pull to somewhere else or to forgetting
